6.60 rsInvalidColumnGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidColumnGrouping is a critical error that will occur (if a ColumnGrouping contains either none or
both of the following elements: ColumnGrouping.DynamicColumns and
ColumnGrouping.StaticColumns.
